label: Table 2

label: Table 3
caption: Paired comparisons of KinCP with each alternative (GBLUP). P-values are from two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, with Holm adjustment within each endpoint family. Interval scores and all ablation comparisons are in File S2.
